title: Pin the "tool: <Name>" assistant-text line as a documented contract in the archive fixture, or emit kind tool-call events for new captures
notes: closing the prose that announced it. Atrium matches that exact text since
atrium `750ae09`/`5552415` to drop the call and the unmarked `role: "user"`
results archived before `199f393`: 759,708 calls and 692,868 results, 78%
of raw records, measured 2026-10-14. The line is now an undeclared
contract; changing its wording silently readmits every archived result.
Smallest step: pin it in the archive-contract fixture's description, or
emit a `kind: "tool-call"` event for new captures and tell Atrium.

Atrium atrium/ingest/is_rendered_tool_call.py still matches r"tool: [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+(\n|$)" for role assistant. Smallest next step: document the exact line format in the archive-contract fixture description (or add a fixture record using it), and note in the Atrium file that scribe owns it.
